name: Event Ops Systems Sprint
job: Map an event team's fragmented spreadsheets and tools, then deliver a working Airtable operations MVP with clear handoff documentation.
audience: event venues, production teams, conference operators, and small agencies with fragmented operational workflows
format: Fixed-scope productized service: workflow audit, data model, Airtable MVP, automation plan, testing, and handoff

name: Talent Offer & Event Settlement
job: Build a professional artist offer, model the event net, and settle the final deal from one auditable workbook.
audience: small venues, independent promoters, and event producers
format: Two-tab Excel workbook with a clean agent-facing offer and an editable event net model

name: Event Inventory Setup Sprint
job: Connect event bookings to equipment availability so a small production company can prevent double-booking and run reliable load-outs without replacing every operating tool at once.
audience: small event-production, AV, staging, and equipment-rental teams outgrowing spreadsheets
format: Fixed-scope setup service: workflow audit, inventory data cleanup plan, one live booking-to-availability pilot, load-out and return workflow, tests, and handoff

name: Film Budget Readiness Review
job: Find missing costs, unsupported rates, inconsistent assumptions, and grant-readiness gaps in an emerging filmmaker's draft budget before they pay for a full line-producer package.
audience: emerging filmmakers preparing a grant, investor conversation, or first serious production budget
format: Fixed-scope review service: intake, annotated findings, missing-cost register, assumption questions, priority fixes, and a short handoff call; not a full budget or schedule

name: Production Budget Pro
job: Turn a creative brief into a clear production budget with assumptions, crew rates, fringes, contingency, actuals, and a client-ready top sheet.
audience: independent producers, production companies, and creator-led shoots
format: Multi-tab Excel workbook with top sheet, detail, rates, and actuals

name: Event Operations Suite 2.0
job: Connect planning, revenue, sponsor, guest, budget, run-of-show, and post-event workflows in one operating workbook.
audience: independent event producers and small teams
format: Linked Excel and Google Sheets-compatible operating workbook

name: Indie Production Command Center
job: Keep a low-budget film's people, locations, schedule, call sheets, files, and approvals coordinated without a subscription platform.
format: Google Sheets-first production workspace with printable call-sheet outputs
